$comment: Canonical narration source. Edit lines here, then run ./produce.sh — changed lines are re-voiced, unchanged lines hit the TTS cache.

tts.instructions: Voice: a warm, grounded teacher who genuinely likes their students. Tone: calm, curious and a little wry; never salesy or hyped. Pacing: unhurried and conversational, with a small breath at each em dash and a real pause after questions. Emphasis: lean lightly on the contrast words (thinking, click, you). Pronounce 'Keating' as KEE-ting and 'keating.help' as 'keating dot help'.
tts.$voice_notes: fal Gemini TTS uses one of its 30 built-in voices; delivery is shaped by instructions. See ../voice-casting/fal/index.html and ../voice-casting/cartesia/index.html for auditions.

scenes.text: Seen this before? You asked to learn — and you got more to read.
You do the thinking. Keating helps it click — a teacher that starts with your goals, and builds on what you already know.
Ask it anything, and it asks you something back.
Not another wall of text. A question you can actually answer.
Choose your model. Shape your teacher. Take your data with you. It's open source.
New in Keating 4: talk it through out loud, with GPT Live.
Local recall brings back what you said before, on your own device — so reviews and courses pick up where you left off.
Independent reviews propose what could change. You decide what sticks.
In your browser — or right in your terminal.
Done offloading? Ready to think for yourself? Start at keating.help.
